title: Wireless Extensions
body: Wireless extensions make a floating screen between them, without any glass in between. Right-click one to link it to a projector within 64 blocks (only to a projector whose channel you may see).

The projector's WIRELESS screen shows the extensions in order and lets you reorder or remove them while it is off. Four of them in the corners of a rectangle can also raise a [[cloak_field|cloak field]].
